'''Balmtop''' was the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Deity/Legends|god]] of putrefaction and [[Disease/Legends|disease]] in the [[Gungan religion|religion]] of the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Species/Legends|Species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Balmtop, along with other [[Gud/Legends|guds]] in the pantheon associated with [[Death/Legends|mortality]] and decay, was under the influence of [[Mekamok]], the god of destruction.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Balmtop was mentioned in the [[Wikipedia:French language|French]] edition of the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' in the Gungan DataBank entry.<ref name="GB" />
